description: A Flexbox stack — `direction` picks the axis, `gap` the spacing (a density-scaled Context token per step), `wrap` whether the row may break onto additional lines, and `align`/`justify` the alignment, all as modifier classes. No inline styles: the alignment props are curated presets, not raw CSS keywords.

contractProps.name: direction
contractProps.description: Flex axis, and its resting or reversed order — the four `flex-direction` keywords directly.

contractProps.name: gap
contractProps.description: Space between children; each step (except none) is a density-scaled Context token.

contractProps.name: align
contractProps.description: Cross-axis alignment (`align-items`), as a preset set rather than a raw CSS passthrough.

contractProps.name: wrap
contractProps.description: Whether children may wrap onto additional lines when the main axis runs out of room (`flex-wrap`).

contractProps.name: justify
contractProps.description: Main-axis distribution (`justify-content`), as a preset set rather than a raw CSS passthrough.
